metricDefinitions.label: computed hop
metricDefinitions.definition: BFS shortest-path edge count between query entities in the independently parsed semantic graph.

source.label: Frozen Stage B0 split reports and validation
Stage B1 Primary layerwise probe results

metricDefinitions.label: Macro-F1
metricDefinitions.definition: Unweighted mean of per-class F1 across the eight non-overlap spatial relations.

metricDefinitions.label: Behavior accuracy
metricDefinitions.definition: Fraction of test examples where the highest summed conditional log-probability among eight frozen answer candidates matches the gold relation.

metricDefinitions.label: Behavior accuracy
metricDefinitions.definition: Frozen summed candidate conditional-log-probability accuracy; chance is 0.125.

metricDefinitions.label: Late-layer mean Macro-F1
metricDefinitions.definition: Arithmetic mean of layerwise Macro-F1 across preregistered layers L16 through L31.

metricDefinitions.label: Late transfer mean
metricDefinitions.definition: Macro-F1 of the h1-trained decoder on the target hop, averaged over layers L16 through L31.

metricDefinitions.label: Transfer gap
metricDefinitions.definition: Within-hop Macro-F1 minus h1-trained transfer Macro-F1 on the same target hop and layer; summarized over L16–L31.

rows.note: 尾段反复重复J是N的西南方、N在O西方，未完成I相对J的查询组合。
反复循环G在D南方、D在F西南方，未输出真实思考关闭边界。
尾段反复重复Y在K左方、K在L右方，停留在局部关系，没有完成L相对S的推导。

rows.process_assessment: 最终错误；末尾坐标计算局部一致，最终查询方向错误
rows.note: 末尾给出D=(0,0)、B=(-3,-2)，这支持D在B右上方，却按B相对D回答LOWER_LEFT。局部坐标计算与最终答案正确性可以分离。

rows.process_assessment: 最终错误；未形成可靠的单位位移组合
rows.note: 引入自由距离和多个布局，末尾选择其认为多数例子出现的LOWER_RIGHT；按数据集单位位移约定横向抵消，应为BELOW。

rows.process_assessment: 最终正确；整段过程有效性未验证，末尾论证不足
rows.note: 末尾明确在假设P在B左上方的前提下选择UPPER_LEFT，没有在该段证明此目标关系。不能把最终正确直接标为已验证正确过程。

rows.process_assessment: 最终正确；末尾单位坐标算例局部一致，整段过程未完全验证
rows.note: 末尾算例G=(0,3)、D=(1,2)、W=(2,1)、Z=(2,2)、A=(0,2)符合查询链并支持RIGHT；此前反复考虑自由距离与其他布局，因此这里只认可所检查末尾算例。
